semiconductor_relevance: Medium — SEBO MEC Corporation specializes in facility construction technologies that are applicable to semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: SEBO MEC Corporation has been a leader in the Korean facility construction industry since 1978, focusing on technologies for HVAC, temperature, humidity, and contamination control. They provide innovative solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, including self-manufactured materials and advanced construction methods.

regional_presence.Korea: SEBO MEC Corporation is based in Korea and has established the largest factory in the facility construction industry there.
